covenant.quote:
Ratio" means, as of the last day of any Fiscal Quarter (including the last day of a Fiscal Quarter which is also the last
day of a Fiscal Year), the ratio, calculated on a consolidated basis for Borrower and its Subsidiaries, of (a) the positive difference
of (i) Funded Debt as of such date minus (ii) Domestic Cash as of such date to (b) the sum of (i) the
positive difference of (A) Funded Debt as of such date minus (B) Domestic Cash as of such date plus (ii) Stockholders'
Equity as of such date.

thresholds.quote:
Net Leverage Ratio. Permit the Total Net Leverage Ratio, as of the last day of any Fiscal Quarter, to be greater than 0.60 to
1.00.

terms.label: Funded Debt
children_labels: Guaranty Obligations in connection with Synthetic Leases

evidence.quote:
Debt" means, as of the date of determination, without duplication, the sum of (a) all principal Indebtedness
of Borrower and its Subsidiaries for borrowed money (including debt securities issued by Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries) on that
date plus (b) Guaranty Obligations in connection with Synthetic Leases, plus (c) the aggregate amount of all
Capital Lease Obligations of Borrower and its Subsidiaries on that date, plus (d) all Letter of Credit Usage

terms.label: Domestic Cash

evidence.quote:
"Domestic Cash" means the lesser of (a) 100% of unrestricted
and unencumbered Cash of Borrower and its Domestic Subsidiaries maintained in the United States and (b) $500,000,000.

terms.note: Netted from Funded Debt in both numerator and denominator of the Total Net Leverage Ratio.

evidence.quote:
Equity" means, as of any date of determination for Borrower and its Subsidiaries on a consolidated basis, stockholders'
equity as of that date determined in accordance with GAAP.

Lease Obligations" means all monetary obligations of a Person under any leasing or similar arrangement which, in accordance
with GAAP, is classified as a Capital Lease.

of Credit Usage" means, as at any date of determination, the aggregate amount available to be drawn under all outstanding
Letters of Credit plus the aggregate amount of all Unreimbursed Amounts

amendments_considered.what_changed: Not an amendment: separate Term Loan Agreement dated 2025-08-14 with its own Section 7.6 Total Net Leverage Ratio covenant. No amendment to the 2024 Second A&R Credit Agreement found via full-text search.

draft_notes: This is a debt-to-capitalization test even though the agreement names it 'Total Net Leverage Ratio': (Funded Debt - Domestic Cash) / ((Funded Debt - Domestic Cash) + Stockholders' Equity). kind=max_leverage is a judgment call (could be 'other'); denominator_label records only the Stockholders' Equity component.
test_period=point_in_time because all components are balance-sheet amounts as of the quarter end.
effective_from 2024-09-30 = first fiscal quarter end after the 2024-09-10 agreement date (assumed first test).
The prior (2020 A&R) Reliance credit agreement, in force for 2023 to Sept 2024, was not labeled.
Compliance certificate (Exhibit B) labels the equity line "Shareholders' Equity" but the defined term in Section 1.1 is "Stockholders' Equity".
